verdict: Organic traffic is rising, but paid campaigns are off and GBP activity dropped sharply.
narrative: Paid advertising carried zero spend across Meta and Google for the full 28-day period, meaning no paid-driven revenue this window. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile generated 428 actions over 28 days — 43 calls, 88 direction requests, and 297 website clicks — but GBP activity fell -84% in the last 7 days, ending the week at a near-complete stop. Website traffic is moving in the right direction, up nearly 13% week over week, which shows real organic interest in the brand. Paid campaigns are being prepared for relaunch, with the Meta funnel test and tracking infrastructure closing out by August 31.
